chose: The big-play algebra's third size is `memorable` (60+ yards, "the kind you remember", the owner's words), and a kick return counts as big only from `huge` (40+): the recorded game's ordinary returns ran 22 to 29 yards, out of the end zone to about the 25, and the owner's examples of a big play were 50 and 70 yards. Each kind's smallest size is in the catalog dump (`kinds[].least`), so the phone shows the same rule. A return is credited to the returning side, and an onside kick is never a kick return.
options: Kick returns from `huge` (chosen): no routine return reads as a big play; a 47-yard one does.
Every kind from `big` (20+, D8 as worded): every kickoff in the recorded game but one touchback would be a big play.
Measure a kick return by field position past the touchback line: closer to the feeling, but a second yardage rule the phone would have to learn.
gray: D8 gave the sizes without saying whether they apply alike to every kind; the tier's slug was not named.
